### 문서
- `SKILL.md` — Structures standing handoff docs as per-topic detail files fronted by one list-format index — every topic file gets exactly one index line, unlisted means forgotten, and updates splice one file plus its line. Use when writing or organizing handoff/continuity docs, splitting a growing monolithic handoff by topic, or setting a project's handoff convention.
